items.claim: GitHub publishes the Primer design-system site at the recorded owner URL.
items.notes: This establishes source identity and public availability only.

items.claim: The corpus reads Primer as a reusable-foundation system for dense technical products, where recurrence should be solved with shared behavior rather than isolated styling.
items.notes: Source-bounded analyst interpretation after the former product path was found to redirect.

items.claim: Responsive utility and semantic color modes are retained as adaptation requirements, not as claims that the current root page documents every former foundation detail.
items.notes: The statement deliberately separates corpus judgment from direct observation.

items.claim: In developer tools, preserve compact clarity, status legibility, and reliable interaction; do not treat GitHub's neutral palette as the transferable system.
